name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Variety 6-Pack
description:
BUY 5, GET 1 FREE value! Experience the ultimate flavor journey with our Double-Stacked BITEZ Variety 6-Pack (no substitutions)! This premium collection features six distinct dual-layer gummy flavors, each infused with a potent Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend. Every jar contains 10,000mg total (1,000mg per gummy, 10 gummies per jar) for maximum impact and variety. That's 60 gummies for the price of 50!

Inside Your 6-Pack Is A Jar Of Each:

• 
Blue Razz - Tangy blueberry meets bold raspberry

• 
Cherry Mango - Sweet cherry blends with tropical mango

• 
Melon Berry - Refreshing melon paired with mixed berry

• 
Raspberry Peach - Tart raspberry complements juicy peach

• 
Strawberry Lemonade - Classic strawberry and zesty lemonade

• 
Strawberry Watermelon - Sweet strawberry fused with fresh watermelon
